name: html-report
description: Write work reports, status updates, review results and meeting notes that render as a polished document (property table, serif title, lead, sections, chips) in any host and model: Claude, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode. Picks the form per host: structured markdown with flat frontmatter for document viewers (Claude desktop, SpecWithCode, Obsidian), or a self-contained HTML page from the bundled template when the report needs screenshots, comparisons or test matrices (SpecWithCode html_render, Claude artifacts, a file on disk). Use only when a result needs a report (several findings, evidence links, screenshots, tables or comparisons) or the user asks for one; a short result, especially under a concise response style, stays a plain 1-3 line message. Fits final reports, summaries, handoffs and release notes, or when the user says 'make it look good', 'pretty report', 'HTML report', 'artifact', 'format this as a document', or complains a report is a wall of text.
